name: What is the process for clearing a clogged floor drain?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for clearing a clogged floor drain?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process often begins with removing the drain cover and attempting to remove visible debris by hand or with a pair of pliers. For deeper clogs, a plumber might use a drain snake (auger) to break up or retrieve the blockage. If the clog is severe or deep within the pipe, hydro-jetting, which uses high-pressure water, may be employed to thoroughly clean the pipe walls. For persistent issues, a camera inspection can identify the exact cause and location of the problem.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clearing a floor drain involves removing debris, using a drain snake for deeper clogs, or hydro-jetting for severe blockages. Camera inspection may be used for persistent issues.
